source.name: Torrent
source.originalDescription: When this Pokémon deals damage to opposing Pokémon, or as time passes, the Torrent gauge increases to a max of 100. If a move is used when the Torrent gauge exceeds 50, 50 points of the gauge is consumed and the move becomes boosted. The rate at which the Torrent gauge increases depends on your current HP with thresholds at: above 66% HP, below 66% HP, and below 33% HP. Every second gain 1/2/3 Torrent gauge.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Torrent は スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Piplup shoots a blast of water, becoming a boosted attack with every third attack dealing increased damage. Basic and Boosted attacks increase Torrent gauge by 2/3/4. When evolved into Prinplup or Empoleon, basic attacks become melee ranged. The user slices with their wings, becoming a boosted attack with every third attack dealing increased damage. Boosted attack increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20. This Pokémon heals 15% of damage dealt with basic and boosted attacks.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は 与ダメージを変化させる、HPを回復する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる、与ダメージに応じて回復する。

source.name: Sovereign Slide
source.originalDescription: Has the user slide at high speed in the designated direction and form a whirlpool on impact, or when the maximum distance is reached, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and throwing them for 1s. The whirlpool remains centered on the user for 7s and applies a 50% slow to opposing Pokémon in the area. The slow lasts 1s when opposing Pokémon leave the area. Empoleon is unstoppable throughout this move. The longer the user slides, the faster the recovery to perform other actions. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when the move connects. While the whirlpool is active the amount of Torrent gauge gained per second is increased to 12/18/24. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Sovereign Slide は 相手を打ち上げる、移動速度を下げる、妨害無効になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。
